text: I work as a backend developer at a fintech startup called PayNest.
My manager is Farhan, he's pretty relaxed but very detail-oriented in code reviews.
I have a cat named Miso, she's three years old and very lazy.
I play badminton every Saturday morning with my friend Tanvir.
Tanvir is also my coworker, he does the frontend at PayNest.
Photography is my weekend hobby. I shoot with a Fujifilm X-T30.
My favourite food is kacchi biryani, I could eat it every week.
I love mango lassi, especially in summer.
My best friend Nadia is getting married in December.
I'm learning Japanese on Duolingo, I'm on a 60 day streak.
I want to visit Kyoto someday, that's partly why I'm learning Japanese.
I use VS Code with the Dracula theme for everything.
Our main backend language at work is Go.
We deploy all our services on AWS.
I usually drink two cups of black coffee a day.
My laptop is a 2019 ThinkPad and it's getting really slow.
I prefer window seats when I fly.
My mom's birthday is on 12 May.
I'm reading Atomic Habits right now, it's pretty good.
I go to the gym on Monday and Wednesday evenings.
I really don't like horror movies.
My favourite dessert is rasmalai.
I also enjoy baking banana bread on Sundays.
Miso needs her yearly vaccine next month.
I'm saving money for a new 35mm camera lens.
My commute is about 40 minutes by bus.
Nadia loves Korean dramas, she keeps sending me recommendations.
I usually go to sleep around midnight.
Farhan asked me to lead the payments API refactor.
The payments API refactor has to be done by the end of February.
I'm a big football fan and I support Argentina.
I like spicy food, the spicier the better.
I recently started using Notion to organise my tasks.
On weekends I usually visit my parents in the afternoon.
In the evenings I prefer tea over coffee.
I bought a standing desk last month and it really helps my back.
I'm trying to read one book every month this year.
Tanvir and I are planning a trip to Cox's Bazar in April.
Our team uses GitHub for code reviews and we have strict pull request rules.
I've started learning to play the ukulele, it's harder than it looks.
